Sunday, July 26

Prov. 3:5 Trust in Jehovah with all your heart.

Trusting in Jehovah means relying on him completely, not leaning on our own understanding of a situation.

This kind of trust grows the more we come to know Jehovah through his Word and through our own experiences.

We show that we trust Jehovah when we obey his commands even when we do not fully understand the reasons behind them.
